chris: quick follow-up from the postmortem — capturing owners + short ETAs for token/rotation remediation. please ack and add if missing.

rina: ack, i'll take the rotation-verification automation and playbook updates.

abe: ack, will own validation hardening and the canary policy.

katie: ack, i'll do audit-log enrichment + dashboard tiles.

chris: items i captured: 
- R1: validation hardening (strict sig+kid+exp checks) — owner: abe — ETA: 10d
- R2: preflight rotation-verification job (CI + gating) — owner: rina — ETA: 14d
- R3: increase auth audit sampling + add token_kid field (45d retention) — owner: katie — ETA: 5d
- R4: surface validation failures in alerts + runbook link (pager at 0.5%/15m) — owner: katie — ETA: 7d
- R5: weekly rotation health job for 8 weeks + pulse report — owner: ops-bot / infra — ETA: 3d to schedule

sso-bot: Incident 2024-07-11 token-rotation: created remediation tickets R1..R5, linked to team: infra-security.

rina: plan for R2: preflight step verifies secret presence across envs, post-merge smoke rotates in canary regions and validates tokens. gate blocks if success_rate < 99.5%. I'll post CI snippet in PR.

abe: R1 approach: add unit+integration for kid mismatch, reject malformed tokens early. will run canary 72h after merge. ETA 2024-08-02.

katie: R3/R4: logging change + dashboard PR by 2024-07-28. sampling at 40% for 30d initially. alert: page at 0.5% sustained 15m, post to #security-alerts.

ops-bot: Calendar "rotation-health-checks" created weekly (Weds 09:30 PT) for next 8 weeks.

chris: recurrence note: ops found 4 related failures in last 9 months clustered near vendor rotation windows. agreed mitigation = stronger preflight + gating + visibility.

rina: PR (WIP) for rotation job: https://redwood.internal/pull/4999. includes gating config and rollback hook.

abe: PR for validation checks: https://redwood.internal/pull/5008 (draft). tests included.

katie: logging/dashboard PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/5012 (ready).

chris: summary & next steps: owners to label PRs with "incident-1755554321-remediate", update remediation tracker with final ETA, and confirm here. we'll sync in 1 week to verify progress.

abe: ETA confirmed 2024-08-02.

rina: ETA confirmed 2024-08-08 for full gating + job.

katie: ETA confirmed 2024-07-28.

chris: thanks everyone — closing thread after tracker updated. :thumbsup:
